title: List containers
summary: docker ps lists running containers. Adding -a also shows stopped containers that were not automatically removed.
introduction: docker ps lists running containers. Adding -a also shows stopped containers that were not automatically removed. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: docker ps lists running containers. Adding -a also shows stopped containers that were not automatically removed.
The second list can include stopped containers. Containers run with --rm may no longer appear after exit.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Compare the two lists without changing any containers.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A stopped container and a deleted container are different states.
